data.gender_notes: Chimdindu is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Chimdindu is recorded in name-lists as “God is with us”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Chimdindu expresses “God is with us”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chimdindu total 49, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
